468554.overview:
The shadows of evil are gathering once again in the dark corners of Tokyo Sky City. Only Ryu Hayabusha and his gorgeous teammates, Rachel, Ayane, and Momiji, can banish the vicious Spider Ninja clan and defeat its fierce leader, Genshin. 

Intense ninja combat meets arcade pinball action in this Ninja Gaiden Sigma 2-themed DLC table released for Zen Pinball in 2010, and Pinball FX2 in 2014. Are you up to the challenge, warrior?

469309.overview:
Deep sea adventure with modern polish! Diver chases and underwater mysteries abound.

Nautilus 2018 is a digital-exclusive remake of Zaccaria's electromechanical Nautilus table from 1977.

While the 2018 version retains the core nautical theme featuring ocean life, it introduces significant structural and technical upgrades typical of the "Remake" category in the Zaccaria library.

469427.overview:
Dive deep into adventure! Submarines, sea monsters, and underwater secrets make this a true deep-sea classic.

Released in February 1977, Nautilus is a classic single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine manufactured by the Italian company Zaccaria, featuring an underwater exploration theme.

470522.overview:
Retro table for Visual Pinball X, themed around the classic 1977 Sex Pistols album. Players can cycle through 8-bit audio versions of the entire album using the nudge buttons.

INSTRUCTIONS:

• 1 replay for score of 500 000 points
• 1 replay for collecting Malcolm
• Use the Collect Saucer, or right outlane to collect Anarchy Bonus, Band Bonus and Pistols Bonuses.
• PISTOLS - collect 1st time scores 10 000, 2nd time scores 15 000, 3rd Time Scores 25 000 (MALCOLM)
• Rockstar Hurry-Up scores 2 500
• England’s Dreaming Spinner scores 1 000 per spin when lit
• Matching third number of player’s score to the number on the back glass at the end of game scores 1 replay

471639.overview:
Nightmare is widely considered the most challenging and atmospheric table in the classic 1992 pinball simulation game Pinball Dreams, developed by Digital Illusions. It is the fourth and final table in the set. Although listed as "Nightmare" in the menu, the playfield itself says "Graveyard." This inconsistency was addressed in some later ports, such as the Game Boy version, which renamed the table in the menu as "Graveyard".

The table is themed around a graveyard, ghosts, demons, and evil occurrences. It features dark, Gothic-inspired artwork with crosses, tombs, and eerie visuals, and it is known for having a very steep table design, making it difficult to keep the ball from moving quickly. The layout and some rules of this table are based on Williams' Terminator 2: Judgment Day pinball machine released a year earlier. 

The table is celebrated for having some of the best, most atmospheric music on the Amiga.

A 3D version for the Future Pinball platform was created by users Slash2084, Sebek74, Jerry Winter, and IamMrBongo.

472088.overview:
An original table for Future Pinball based on Wes Craven's supernatural slasher franchise. Although Gottlieb did release a "Freddy: A Nightmare On Elm Street" physical table in 1994, this release by SLAMT1LT has very little in common with that table, and is a superior experience, with better artwork, a more interesting table layout, video clips from the movie, and more satisfying gameplay and features.

A mod with support for FizX3 physics was released by HZR in 2023.

477186.overview:
Nintendo released Pinball for the NES in 1984, and it was an enjoyable, but fairly simple game, with the playfield split over two seperate screens, and a third screen showing a bonus Breakout-like mode.

The table has been recreated in 3D for Future Pinball, with full scrolling (unlike the original game's two-screen setup), enhanced graphics in the bonus stage (now placed in the backglass area of the table), and new Mario-themed in-game music and sound effects.

480515.overview: A re-theme of Barracora (Williams, 1981) for Visual Pinball X by talented modder Tony Fox. The table uses a PuP pack with the music of the Canadian rock band Nickelback for sound.
